cues: Stanza two, three short lines, is the cost.
At every step the old guard, the defenders of the old order, beat their desperate wings and tear her back.
Her back, because she has turned away and will not turn round.
And desperate: they are not calm and powerful; they are frightened.
Stanza three is release: she was unpinned forever, like a branch freed from a wall.
And the paradox: every whiplash only drives her gaze further from the distant, familiar horizons she was taught to aim at.
